_about: The southern, icy Mira Retrum (levels 6-20): killer whales hunt as a pod, the frost sea serpents are elites, and the Ice Leviathan in the quiet bay beyond the ice wall sprays freezing water and calls the pod.

helpers.shout: The killer whale calls, and the pod comes knifing through the water!

45150.name: ice leviathan
45150.long_desc: The Ice Leviathan breaks the surface of the bay, ice cracking from its back.
45150.description: A whale-sized thing of blue-white hide and jagged ice, with a jaw of glassy teeth. The southern sea freezes around it as it moves.

phases.message: The Ice Leviathan rises, and the bay freezes around you!

abilities.name: Freezing Spray
abilities.telegraph: The Ice Leviathan blasts a plume of freezing water!

abilities.name: Crushing Bite
abilities.telegraph: The Ice Leviathan opens its glassy jaws!

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.telegraph: The Ice Leviathan dives, dragging the water after it!

bosses.why: the Ice Leviathan in the quiet bay

mechanics.shout: The Ice Leviathan bellows, and a killer whale answers!
